assessment_contract.subject: The exact newly authored a_c interpretation and lawful declared semantic relations available through its signature and resolution contract. Bind its model identity/digest, basis and generated treatment before grading.
assessment_contract.semantic_support: Required distinctions must be recoverable as authored semantic roles: for example governing constraints, predicate/value meaning, conditional relations, traversal contracts, residuals or their declared combinations. A preserved source quote or link alone is grounding, not substantive authored preservation. Raw extraction fragments or source-graph edges count only insofar as the actual authored interpretation carries the required semantic roles, conditions and authority.
assessment_contract.representation_freedom: Do not require exact words, one record per source section, one record per criterion, a specific family for a concept, one layout, or duplicate bodies when sufficient lawful references carry the meaning. Recover roles across all applicable authored records before judging omission.
assessment_contract.evidence_for_each_grade: For each criterion cite exact generated record identity and field/content location plus its semantic role and applicable source locus; distinguish present meaning, explicit unresolved disposition, omission and contrary settled assertion. Preserve conflicts and failed/refused/incomplete work.
assessment_contract.verdict_order: Contradicted requires a material positive conflict and takes precedence over partial preservation. Otherwise preserved requires every criterion; partial requires some substantive criterion support with a remaining omission/ambiguity; missing means no substantive support. Report per-criterion evidence rather than averaging away a critical conflict.
assessment_contract.unperformed_generation: Missing/refused/partial generation remains observable. Do not invent an authored record or semantic assessment merely to fill the expected set.
assessment_contract.grading_authority: A separate assessor performs F_P semantic fidelity judgment from exact source and exact authored model. Oracle construction, code checks and a successful representation recovery do not accept that model.

required_distinctions.distinction: Independent assessment is claim-relative and selected by the governing contract. Where nonauthor assessment is required, the assessor cannot author the reviewed subject/repair; self-review stays authoring evidence. Fresh contexts, identities or model families alone do not establish independence, and this contract adds no universal reviewer count or model-family requirement.

Preserve assertion provenance (obligation, interpretation, assumptions, derivation, shared dependencies) separately from execution provenance (actual checker, exact subject, environment, inputs, observations, result). Agreement admits common error and disagreement needs diagnosis; actors/families/codebases and repetitions do not establish statistical independence or new evidence. Model validation needs purpose and material external observations through owners.

A quantified claim declares population/uncertainty model, prior information, likelihoods, shared causes and calibration limits. Bayes requires defined used conditionals and a nonzero denominator; exact joint miss factorization uses conditioning on preceding misses, and replacing factors by marginal conditional miss rates requires relevant conditional independence.

One minus joint miss probability is chance of at least one detection under the specified conditions, not whole-product correctness. Agreement need not increase confidence; sampled/injected cases calibrate only their justified operational relation. Unsupported numeric confidence stays unresolved while scoped qualitative evidence remains usable. No universal probability threshold or per-test estimate is imposed; safety, authority and acceptance requirements constrain cheaper plans.

Use execution logs to justify the upstream expected answer or infer the faulty party solely from disagreement.
Multiply miss rates without the needed independence model, turn detection probability into product-correctness probability, or invent priors/calibration.
Treat unsupported confidence as established, mandate a universal numerical threshold, or waive required gates for a cheaper assurance plan.

required_distinctions.distinction: The single five-value core preserves satisfaction, falsification, indeterminate evidence, out_of_frame missing material relation/capability and invalid_basis subject/basis. Predicate and original domain outcome travel with the value; refinements preserve their parent core value and never raise standing or add a success for a non-success.

A planned/required evaluation not performed has no closed result and maps to no core value, including indeterminate. Distinguish it from an exercised but undecidable evaluation. A sufficient applicable evaluation or counterexample obtained without an unexercised capability can still return its supported result, but the unexercised component has no result and remains a residual/gap.

Conjunction keeps three inputs separate: returned closed results, planned assessments without an applicable closed result, and required coverage no planned assessment addresses. A performed stale-basis evaluation returns invalid_basis for its own predicate; a component held only on stale evidence is instead a planned-result gap for this composite, retaining its old record/basis and never relabelling it invalid_basis here.

Failures with counterexamples, planned-result gaps and uncovered obligations survive joins, as do predicates/domain outcomes. Satisfaction requires all mandatory results satisfied with valid evidence, coherent declared basis relations and no gaps. The applying owner declares the non-satisfied rule, with no universal order; where all mandatory returns are satisfied, incoherent declared joins yield invalid_basis and coherent joins plus gaps yield indeterminate. Nonmandatory falsified evidence stays recorded; a material mandatory counterexample cannot project success.

Acquire a current derived surface when it serves the task; for another task or a stale, missing or insufficient surface on a named unresolved question, acquire the exact deciding owner sections directly. A candidate, moving selector or different basis is no substitute. Before dependent action, report the exact missing binding with its appropriate scope/basis outcome.

A derived surface is current only while all named content-affecting source identities match; staleness needs regeneration or explicit source-bound re-acceptance. Identity matching proves neither fidelity nor question sufficiency. A surface decides standalone only questions its source members own; cross-owner questions require all deciding owners or a surface declaring them and otherwise return out_of_frame naming them.

Context size measurement is required before read where the envelope declares context capacity, in its unit and declared boundary; no declared capacity creates no measurement requirement and no universal measurement gate. Boundary fit is separate from a complete-input/upper-bound step fit judgment and from actual adequate attention. Misfit cannot silently omit material or reduce predicates; lawful refinement/sequencing/compression may be selected within grant, while actor/envelope changes re-enter their owner unless delegated.

prohibited_distortions: Require raw owner rereading even when a current task-sufficient derived surface serves the task, or require the whole corpus from its mere presence.
Read another basis or widen access because an input is absent locally; treat acquisition as authority.
Let a one-owner surface close a multi-owner question, or infer fidelity/sufficiency from matching digests.
Make size measurement universal, infer attention or whole-context fit from a measured slice, or silently trim required scope.
probes.significance: The RC8 acquisition law preserves usable permissions and exact fallback conditions. Overstating a universal read or measurement gate would be as unfaithful as omitting a required owner or authority boundary.

required_distinctions.distinction: Assertion justification and evidence validity are related but different relations; the latter includes implementation, libraries, data, instruments, environments and assumptions. Material impact and each check dependency cover are transitive; requirements-to-test trace is not a complete impact model, and the tenant need not use an exhaustive graph database.

Exclusion needs supported dependency coverage and a reason the change cannot invalidate the reused claim. Missing edge is no non-influence evidence; unknown impact widens reassessment or leaves assurance unresolved. New obligations/cases and mandatory policy gates create work irrespective of existing selective coverage. Selection alone provides no execution evidence.

The new account combines applicable retained records and actual reassessment under current claim/scope, justified assertion/observation basis and unchanged or lawfully preserved dependencies. Old records keep their original subject with a new applicability relation. A changed hash proves neither invalidity nor equivalence, and a corrected run is not an unchanged independent test of the correction.

Known failures, unresolved coverage and citations remain until supported repair/reassessment or authorized obligation change. Recovery can retain valid work without rerunning every check; complete governing assurance differs from freshness of every execution. Required assurance/risk/gates constrain total-cost selection, and no optimization removes a separate gate or dictates universal full-suite cadence; a full suite can still have gaps.

probes.title: Independent assurance and quantified confidence keep their premises
probes.source_selected_question: When are assessor judgments independent, and what follows from agreement or a computed detection probability under shared failure causes?

source_loci.heading: 3. Independent assessment

required_distinctions.distinction: Where required, independent assessment is over a stabilized exact subject and cannot assess its own authorship or reuse the constructor judgment; shared mechanical evidence may be reused and an assessor may read the same governing sources. Fresh context is not independence; ported contributions retain authorship. Across-family independence is declared, and whether two same-family activations are independent for a semantic claim follows its governing policy, defaulting to not independent if silent. No fixed actor/round count is prescribed.

Assertion provenance (upstream obligation/interpretation/derivation/assumptions/shared dependencies), execution provenance (actual checker/subject/environment/inputs/observations/result), and returned-result authentication remain different. Agreement permits shared error, disagreement needs diagnosis, different actors/model families/codebases prove no statistical independence and repetition creates no new observation. An incorrect common model is not validated against purpose without the owning external observations.

Quantified assurance declares population/uncertainty, prior, likelihoods, shared causes and calibration limits. Bayes has a nonzero denominator and supplies no missing parameters. Exact joint-miss factorization uses prior misses in each conditional; defined conditioning events are required, and simpler factors need conditional independence under the declared model.

One minus joint miss probability means at least one detection under the specified conditions, not whole-product correctness; agreement need not increase confidence. Sampled/injected defects calibrate only a justified operational relation. Unsupported numeric confidence stays unresolved with scoped qualitative evidence usable; no universal threshold or per-test probability is required, and a cheaper assurance plan cannot waive safety, authority or acceptance conditions.

prohibited_distortions: Relabel same-author fresh-context review as independent or assume same-family independence where the policy is silent.
Infer statistical independence or new observations from different agents, copied assertions or repeated agreement.
Use authentication/logs as proof of assertion derivation; diagnose the faulty party solely by disagreement.
Multiply marginal miss rates without the needed model, equate detection probability to product correctness, or assert unsupported confidence/thresholds.
probes.significance: This preserves the exact RC8 independence default alongside the separate statistical dependence account. Graph extraction confidence and actor agreement do not establish either kind of assurance.
